name: GlideSecureRandomUtil
title: GlideSecureRandomUtil - Scoped, Global
summary: The GlideSecureRandomUtil API provides methods for generating integers, long values, and strings.
overview: There is no constructor for this class. Methods are accessed through the static object GlideSecureRandomUtil. The GlideSecureRandomUtil class is available in both global and scoped applications.

members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Number The pseudo-randomly generated integer. 
gs.info(GlideSecureRandomUtil.getSecureRandomInt());
Output:

members.name: getSecureRandomIntBound
members.summary: Generates a pseudo-random integer between 0 (inclusive) and the bound (exclusive) value that you pass into the method.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
bound Number The bound value.
Returns
Type Description
Number The pseudo-randomly generated integer. 
gs.info(GlideSecureRandomUtil.getSecureRandomIntBound(100));
Output:
55
